style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, warm analog film grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling. No text, no captions, no inscriptions, no readable letters, no film stock branding, no Kodak or Portra labels, no frame numbers, no aspect ratio markers, no watermarks. No modern objects, no asphalt, no painted road markings, no vehicles, no cars, no motorcycles, no machinery. No human figures, no faces, no body parts, no hands. 1st-century Mediterranean Levantine setting only.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: Calling the First Disciples
images.concept: After a night of nothing — abundance at a single word, then everything left behind
images.imageAlt: Dark water surface at dawn with one band of warm reflected light, an old rope coiled at the edge of the frame
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, still dark water surface at pre-dawn hour seen from above, one horizontal band of pale warm light reflected from the horizon turning a stripe of the water faintly amber while the rest remains near-black, an old thick rope coiled at the bottom edge of the frame on rough wet wood, the rope weathered and salt-stiffened, heavy warm analog film grain throughout, muted almost-monochrome palette with the one warm water reflection as sole warmth note, the water carries the entire weight of the moment, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9 landscape

images.title: Cleansing the Leper
images.concept: Touch across the boundary no one crossed — the outcast restored to community
images.imageAlt: Two rough stone surfaces separated by a narrow gap, one side in full light, one in total shadow, a single dry leaf in the gap
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close macro view of two ancient rough stone surfaces separated by a narrow gap, the left stone catching full warm light while the right stone remains in deep shadow, a single dry crumbled leaf rests in the shadowed gap between them, the boundary between light and dark falling precisely in the middle of the frame, heavy warm analog film grain especially visible in the shadow stone, warm stone tones heavily desaturated, the gap between the stones is the theological subject, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9 landscape

images.title: Healing and Forgiving the Paralytic
images.concept: Let down through a roof — desperation creates access, and forgiveness precedes healing
images.imageAlt: Looking straight up through a square opening in a clay and wood ceiling into bright overexposed sky, the rough edges of the opening in shadow
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, extreme upward shot looking directly through a roughly cut square opening in an ancient clay and stick ceiling, the edges of the opening in deep warm shadow revealing the layered construction, the sky visible through the gap overexposed to pure white, the ceiling texture rough and organic close up and then dissolving into the white beyond, heavy film grain in the dark ceiling, muted warm clay tones against white sky, the opening is the entire subject — a hole made by desperate love, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9 landscape with the opening centered and taking up roughly one-third of the frame

images.title: Calling Levi and Table Fellowship
images.concept: A table set for those no one else would invite — the feast as declaration of worth
images.imageAlt: An empty wooden table surface seen from above, a clay cup and scattered breadcrumbs in soft evening light
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, overhead view of an ancient worn wooden table surface, a single unglazed clay cup sits slightly off-center with a few scattered breadcrumbs around it, soft warm evening light falling from one side casting long gentle shadows, the wood grain of the table deeply visible, heavy warm analog film grain throughout, muted warm palette of faded wood and clay, nothing else on the table — the invitation is the space, the cup and crumbs evidence of a meal just shared or about to begin, Kinfolk editorial stillness, 16:9

images.title: New Wine Parable
images.concept: New life cannot be contained in old structures — the wineskin bursts, the garment tears
images.imageAlt: A cracked and split old clay vessel on a stone shelf, a dark stain spreading from the crack across the pale stone surface
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close study of a cracked old unglazed clay vessel sitting on a pale stone ledge, a split running along the vessel's side, a dark stain of absorbed liquid spreading slowly from the crack across the stone surface below, the vessel's surface showing age and use, warm raking side light revealing every texture, heavy film grain in the shadows, muted palette of terracotta and pale stone, the crack and stain carry the entire meaning — old forms inadequate for new content, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9 landscape
